summary: DTO fields and helper functions are pub, so other crates can build structs that bypass clamping and saturation; a NaN usagePercent would serialise as null
evidence: system.rs pub fields; no literal bypass found in repo today
failure_scenario: CpuStatus { usage_percent: f32::NAN, .. } outside this file -> "usagePercent": null -> Home.svelte width null%. Not exploitable today.
